name: 30467 · Sylvania, GA
findings: ZIP 30467 (Sylvania) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30467 (Sylvania) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
